PhotoImport.//Deployment: JSON settings only. Set FWD_PHOTO_CONFIG_FILE to an external JSON absolute path. No per-setting environment or command-line overrides; never commit real infrastructure paths.
PhotoImport.//XmlPhotoPath: Empty/omitted disables XML (ZIP-only); set a single CrossFire XML file path to enable it
PhotoImport.//AppliedManifestPath: Empty defaults to photo-applied-manifest.json beside WatermarkFilePath
PhotoImport.//XmlAuditDirectory: Server-local directory; the execution account requires write access; do not use a NAS path
